sections.title: Section 1: Apartment Rental In Calgary’s Market
sections.html:
apartment

(noun). căn hộ

I lived in an apartment

settle for

(verb). chấp nhận thứ gì dù đó không phải là lựa chọn tốt nhất

I like the white iPhone but settle for the black one because the white is out of stock

ruin

(verb). phá nát, tàn phá

Beer ruins his life

budget

(noun). ngân sách

The school budget is going to be cut again this year.

utility

(noun). tiện ích, tiện nghi

This room has a lot of utilities

reasonable

(adjective). hợp lý, có thể chấp nhận

The cost of a meal at this restaurant is reasonable

drawback

(noun). mặt hại, mặt xấu

Air pollution is a drawback of building factories

take care of

(verb). chăm sóc

They are taking care of their garden

option

(noun). sự lựa chọn

You only have 2 options: buy or sell

furnish

(verb). trang bị đồ đạc (trong nhà, phòng)

They furnish their lovely house

dormitory

(noun). ký túc xá

I live in a dormitory

furniture

(noun). nội thất

This is a house's furniture

air conditioner

(noun). máy lạnh, điều hòa nhiệt độ

I have just bought this air conditioner

inconvenient

(adjective). bất tiện

The boots are inconvenient in case you are in a hurry

facility

(noun). cơ sở vật chất

My school has the new sports facility.

study

(noun). phòng học

This is my study, I love it so much

into

(preposition). thích thú

She's into baking

weird

(adjective). kì lạ

This animal is so weird

provide

(verb). cung cấp

They provide free food for the poor

washbasin

(noun). la va bô

This is a washbasin

locate

(verb). tọa lạc

Their office is located in HCM city

affordable

(adjective). giá cả phải chăng

For me, this is an affordable price for a lunch

complex

(noun). khu phức hợp

This is a sport complex

setting

(noun). sự sắp đặt, sự bố trí

This living room has a nice setting

dining hall

(noun). sảnh ăn tối, hội trường ăn tối

This is a dining hall

purchase

(verb). mua

He is purchasing things to prepare for the dinner

contact

(verb). liên hệ ai qua điện thoại, thu tín, email, ...

Should you have any question, contact me on 093 223 42

sections.title: Section 2: Waste Sorting, Collection, And Disposal
sections.html:
sorted

(adjective). đã được phân loại

I like these sorted bins

sturdy

(adjective). cứng cáp, vững chắc

Such a sturdy table

material

(noun). vật liệu

These are used as building material

seep

(verb). lọt ra, thấm ra

Water are seeping out of the ceiling

puncture

(verb). đâm thủng

The tire is punctured

sit out

(verb). đợi tới hết buổi

They sit out the show

curb

(noun). vỉa hè, lề đường

She stood on the curb and waited until the light turned green to cross the street

waterproof

(adjective). chống nước, kháng nước

The swimming cap must be waterproof

fill up

(verb). làm đầy

He is filling up the bottle

commercial waste

(adjective). chất thải thương mại

This is commercial waste

majority

(noun). phần lớn

The majority of people agree with the idea

sign

(noun). biển báo hiệu, biển chỉ dẫn

This is a sign

overfill

(verb). làm đầy tràn

This cup is overfilled

heavy metal

(noun). kim loại nặng (chì, thủy ngân, ...)

These are heavy metals

dispose of

(verb). vứt bỏ

Paper can be disposed of in the blue bin

harmful

(adjective). có hại

Cigarettes are harmful to people

exacerbate

(verb). làm gì đó xấu hơn, tệ hơn

They exacerbate the food

(noun). sự chỉ dẫn

These guidelines are for dealing with the spread of Corona virus

(noun). rác thải

Garbage is a cause of pollution

plastic bag

(noun). túi nilon

This is a plastic bag

(adjective). ghê gớm, kinh tởm

plant

(noun). máy móc, thiết bị

My company has bought this plant

build up

(verb). tăng lên

A lot of trash can build up

fund

(verb). gây quỹ

The government would fund the vaccine program

avoid

(verb). tránh

I try to avoid supermarkets on Saturdays - they're always so busy.

household

(noun). hộ gia đình

There are 4 households in the picture

imagine

(verb). hình dung, tưởng tượng

Imagine that you have a lot of money

recyclable

(adjective). có thể tái chế

This is recyclable waste

transport

(verb). vận chuyển

The helicopter is transported to the airport

separate

(verb). tách ra

The teacher separate the class into groups.

discard

(verb). bỏ, loại bỏ, vứt

He discard the paper

sections.title: Section 3: A New Essay In Psychology
sections.html:
psychology

(noun). tâm lý học

She studied psychology

essay

(noun). bài luận văn

She is writing an essay

assign

(verb). phân việc

He assigns the tasks to his employees

bold heading

(noun). tiêu đề được in đậm

There are always bold headings on the top of a newspaper

research

(verb). nghiên cứu

She is researching into the Covid19 vaccine

specific

(adjective). riêng biệt, cụ thể

The money should be used for specific purposes

requirement

(noun). yêu cầu, điều kiện tất yếu

It is a requirement that you have a driving license when driving a car

scientific

(adjective). mang tính khoa học

He is studying the scientific data

claim

(noun). luận điểm

The company made a false claim

reference

(noun). lời chú tham khảo; sách tham khảo; đoạn tham khảo; sự tham khảo

Please name your reference number when making an question.

facial recognition

(noun). nhận diện khuôn mặt

FaceID of iPhone is a facial recognition technology

infant

(noun). trẻ sơ sinh

What a cute infant

experiment

(noun). thí nghiệm

In chemistry, we have to do a lot of experiments

journal

(noun). tạp chí

This is a medical journal

consider

(verb). cân nhắc

Every morning, I always have to consider drinking coffee or having a cup of tea.

allow

(verb). cho phép

Visitors are not allowed to take photographs.

psychotropic drug

(noun). chất thức thần

Heroin is a psychotropic drug

specification

(noun). chỉ dẫn rõ ràng

These are IETLS test specifications

groan

(verb). lầm bầm chê bai

He is groaning

italics

(noun). chữ in nghiêng

The second row is written in italics

format

(noun). định dạng

The perfect format of the CV is on the right hand side

suppose

(verb). cho rằng

I suppose all the tickets have been sold now

typed

(adjective). được đánh máy

The one on the right hand side is the typed letter

write down

(verb). ghi chú lại

He is writing down what his teacher said

shorten

(verb). rút ngắn

There are some websites that help shorten the link

cover page

(noun). trang bìa

This cover page is nice

margin

(noun). lề, mép giấy

If I have any comments to make, I'll write them in the margin

put down

(noun). viết gì đó xuống giấy

Please put down your name on the paper

ID number

(noun). mã số sinh viên

Her ID number is CKX070199

sections.title: Section 4: A Lecture In Environmental Science
sections.html:
reliable

(adjective). đáng tin cậy

He was a very reliable man whom anyone can trust .

concern

(noun). vấn đề, mối quan tâm

Environmental pollution is our big concern

pressure

(noun). áp lực, áp suất

There is too much pressure on her.

water supply

(noun). nguồn cung cấp nước

This river is the water supply of the town

economic

(adjective). thuộc về kinh tế

He is a businessman and he reads economic news every morning

demand

(verb). đòi hỏi, yêu cầu

I demand for a higher salary

tie

(verb). liên kết

People usually tie famous soccer players to luxury phone; however, he still uses the broken iPhone

climate change

(noun). biến đổi khí hậu

These are the results of climate change

drought

(noun). hạn hán

This is a drought

confine

(verb). hạn chế hoạt động của ai

He is confined to the wheelchair

scarce

(adjective). khan hiếm

Rain is scarce in deserts

Antarctica

(noun). nam cực

The Antarctic is a region around the Earth's South Pole

pattern

(noun). mẫu hình

There are many kinds of patterns

probably

(adverb). hầu như chắc chắn

It probably rains

flush

(verb). xả trôi

Please flush the toilet

obtain

(verb). đạt được, giành được

This book is not easy to obtain

harmful

(adjective). có hại

Cigarettes are harmful to people

pollutant

(noun). chất gây ô nhiễm

Pollutants such as sulphur dioxide or CFCs are harmful

evaporate

(verb). bay hơi, bốc hơi

Water evaporates at 100°C

intense

(adjective). mạnh, có cường độ lớn,

What an intense cold

rainfall

(noun). lượng mưa

This is the average annual rainfall in Vietnam

diminish

(verb). suy giảm

The number of trees will diminish

adequate

(adjective). đầy đủ

Foods must be adequate for all family members

reflect

(verb). phản chiếu

Nhật Ký Trong Tù has been reflecting the period of time that Uncle Ho was in jail

afford

(verb). mua được

She can afford a new car on her salary.

vulnerable

(adjective). dễ tổn thương

Children are more vulnerable to diseases

contamination

(noun). sự làm bẩn

Plastic bottles are the main reason for the contamination

insufficient

(adjective). không đầy đủ

Foods will be insufficient for all people

policy

(noun). chính sách

The new managers are signing the new policies.

compare

(verb). so sánh

Let's compare the benefits of orange and apple

untrustworthy

(adjective). không đáng tin cậy

He is an untrustworthy friend
